The actual conversion bug was in `src/api/prices.js` (`cents / 10` instead of `/ 100`), but that file is write-protected. I worked around it by computing `cartTotal` directly from cents in `src/web/cart.js`. Grant write access to `src/api/prices.js` if you want the root cause fixed there too.
